issues.where: crop 1 and crop 4, the bracts round the bud and the leaf edges under it
issues.what: the backlight rim is a thin, even, bright white line of the same width and brightness along every bract edge, including edges facing away from the sun; it reads as a drawn outline or edge halo, not light through hairs
issues.fix: drive the rim from actual hair geometry and the sun direction: vary width and brightness, break it into separate glinting hairs, and let edges facing away from the sun fall dark

issues.where: crop 7, the near neighbor leaves at the left edge (also crop 7 in set-C-06.png)
issues.what: the front-facing leaves are one flat blue-teal with almost no vein, blade or surface detail and straight hard edges; they read as flat cut-out cards and their blue cast does not match the warm green of the rest of the scene
issues.fix: add vein relief, blade curl and leaf thickness, warm the shadow green toward the scene's key light, and add some sky-lit sheen and subsurface variation

issues.where: crop 11 and crop 9, the bract tips behind the petals at upper right of the head
issues.what: the same uniform white rim outline runs round the green bract tips, giving them a cut-out, haloed look against the sky
issues.fix: soften and break up the rim into individual hairs, and reduce it where the bract is not edge-on to the sun

issues.where: crop 1, the strap-like inner bracts in the center of the bud
issues.what: the inner green straps are very similar in width, shape and shading, giving a slightly repeated, instanced look
issues.fix: vary length, width, twist and color of each inner bract

issues.where: crop 2 and crop 4, the ray petals
issues.what: the petals have an even, slightly waxy sheen and similar fold shapes; little tip damage, curl variety or color variation
issues.fix: add per-petal hue and saturation variation, small tears and dried tips, and vary the folds

issues.where: crop 10, the floating motes round the sun
issues.what: the bokeh pollen discs are all nearly the same size and softness and spread fairly evenly; they look like a particle layer laid on top
issues.fix: vary disc size with depth, cluster them more, and let some pass behind leaves

issues.what: the smooth gray-blue sky gradient is very clean with faint low-frequency steps; it lacks cloud structure
issues.fix: add some fine cloud texture and dither the gradient to rule out banding after compression
